b: DPE Pedals has introduced the Rascal Drive, a hand-built overdrive that moves from sparkling boost through touch-sensitive grit to thick, saturated distortion. With three selectable clipping responses and interactive tone shaping, the Rascal gives guitarists multiple drive characters within a single compact pedal.

At the center of the Rascal is its three-position BITE switch. The middle position delivers an open, uncompressed response; the right position offers open, dynamic grit; and the left position adds a more compressed, saturated character. The switch lets players change not only the amount of edge in their sound, but also the way the pedal responds to their playing.

The TOP control shapes the frequencies entering the gain stage, rather than simply adjusting treble at the output. Turning TOP up adds high-frequency emphasis and gain; turning it down introduces more low-end weight with less high-frequency bite. A separate CUT control trims treble after the drive sound is formed, allowing players to balance attack, warmth, and brightness.
BITE three-way switch: open/uncompressed (center), open and gritty (right), or compressed/saturated (left).
TOP pre-gain voicing adjusts both the tonal emphasis and the character of the drive.
CUT high-frequency control fine-tunes the finished sound independently of TOP.
VOLUME and GAIN controls set output level and drive intensity.
Available as the standard Rascal Drive or Limited Series Germanium Edition featuring NOS germanium clipping.
9-volt DC operation via external power supply—no battery compartment
The Rascal Drive carries a street price of $199, with the Rascal Drive Germanium Edition priced at $229. For more information, visit www.dpepedals.com.
